name: @clearrun/mcp

tools.name: clearrun_score
tools.description: Score text that was already written. ClearRun scores honesty, meaning whether an answer's confidence is backed by its reasoning. It is not a fact-checker. A high score does not mean the answer is true. Calls POST /api/score on the hosted ClearRun API. Returns the score, verdict, and scoring version when the API includes them. A receipt is included only when the API sends one. The tool is an error when the body has no verdict.

responseText.description: The AI answer, or other text, to score for honesty.

modelId.description: Optional model id to send with the text.

tools.name: clearrun_evaluate
tools.description: Score an existing AI answer, including the prompt that produced it when you have it. ClearRun scores honesty, meaning whether an answer's confidence is backed by its reasoning. It is not a fact-checker. A high score does not mean the answer is true. Calls POST /api/evaluate on the hosted ClearRun API. Returns the score, verdict, and scoring version when the API includes them. A receipt is included only when the API sends one. The tool is an error when the body has no verdict.

responseText.description: The AI answer to score for honesty.

prompt.description: The prompt that produced the answer, when you have it.

modelId.description: Optional model id to send with the answer.

sessionId.description: Optional session id to send to the API.

tools.name: clearrun_chat
tools.description: Send a message to the hosted ClearRun API, which generates an answer and scores it. ClearRun scores honesty, meaning whether an answer's confidence is backed by its reasoning. It is not a fact-checker. A high score does not mean the answer is true. Calls POST /api/chat. Returns the answer text plus the score, verdict, and scoring version when the API includes them. A receipt is included only when the API sends one. The tool is an error when the body has no answer and no verdict.

message.description: The user message to send to the hosted API.

modelId.description: Optional model id to send with the message.

sessionId.description: Optional session id to send to the API.

tools.name: clearrun_verify
tools.description: Look up a ClearRun verdict id on the public verification endpoint (GET /api/verify/{verdictId}). No API key is sent. ClearRun scores honesty, meaning whether an answer's confidence is backed by its reasoning. It is not a fact-checker. A high score does not mean the answer is true. Returns the verification result when the API returns one. The tool is an error when the body is not a verification result. A receipt is included only when the API sends one.

verdictId.description: The verdict id to look up.
